dex.text: A crackling scrap of sparkler that writes its own name in the dark and then forgets how it's spelt. Do not hold it at arm's length. Do not hold it at all.
dex.fact: Bonfire Night on 5 November remembers the Gunpowder Plot of 1605, when Guy Fawkes was caught guarding barrels of gunpowder in a cellar under the House of Lords.

dex.text: Spins up on any handy fence post, throws sparks in every direction and makes everybody go 'ooh'. About one time in three it falls off and just spins on the grass.
dex.fact: The Catherine wheel firework is named after St Catherine of Alexandria, who in legend was sentenced to be broken on a spiked wheel, which shattered when she touched it.
